answer.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment for SMB self-serve accounts. Shortened onboarding has confirmed improvements in time-to-value, adoption, and 30-day retention, while signup simplification improved SMB activation but slightly reduced retention. Avoid broad promotional pricing despite the competitor pressure because it previously lifted acquisition and revenue while materially harming 30-day retention, conflicting with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. Measure churn, qualified revenue, activation, and retention by segment before scaling.
